messages:
Aria: heads-up: AcmeGames reported a major jump in tail latency after we enabled their int8 quant profile last night. Escalating.
Samir: which tenant/model/region?
Aria: tenant=AcmeGames, model=rw-7b-instruct, region=us-west1, dedicated A100 pool. They reported p95 moved from ~170ms -> ~520ms and p99 up to ~1.2s. No 5xxs, just slow and some quality complaints.
Priya: can you paste the quant profile and a repro request? Also ticket id.
Aria: ticket SUP-10321. Quant profile from their tenant config:
```
quant_profile:
  int8_enabled: true
  fp8_enabled: false
  calibration_samples: 2048
  calibration_seed: 9271
  fallback_to_fp16: true
  fallback_threshold: 0.98
```
Aria: repro curl we used:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"rw-7b-instruct\",\"input\":\"Summarize: ...\",\"max_tokens\":256}'
```
Nate: any serving logs around the rollout? maybe calibration ran inline.
Aria: grabbed runtime logs around the time of the change:
```
[2026-03-14T21:03:12Z] quantizer: start calibration samples=2048 model=rw-7b-instruct shard=2
[2026-03-14T21:03:19Z] quantizer: calibration batch 512 latency=320ms
[2026-03-14T21:03:21Z] quantizer: calibration batch 1024 latency=580ms
[2026-03-14T21:03:25Z] quantizer: calibration failed: distribution_mismatch (KL divergence > threshold)
[2026-03-14T21:03:25Z] runtime: fallback triggered to fp16 for shard=2
[2026-03-14T21:03:25Z] runtime: model shard resync, warm start fp16 weights
```
Priya: that confirms calibration was running on prod and failing then triggered fallback. Fallback warms fp16 which can spike latency. Also the calibration batches themselves look expensive.
Helena: is the calibration configured as online (live traffic) or offline? logs imply online sampling during deploy.
Samir: release notes for that profile mention "online calibration" — it samples live traffic. That's risky for production.
Nate: host metrics show GPU memory churn and CPU steal during that window. KV cache misses rose due to shard restarts.
Aria: hypothesis: synchronous online int8 calibration saturated GPU, clogged inference threads, then failure triggered fallback to fp16 which restarts shards -> sustained p95/p99 regression.
Samir: short-term mitigations we can do now:
- disable online calibration for this tenant (flip int8_enabled=false)
- pin model to fp16 until safe rollout
- run calibration on non-critical nodes or stagger shards
- change runtime to do calibration in background worker not on inference threads
Helena: support suggestion: offer to pin them to fp16 and explain cause. We should provide a timeline for a safer workflow.
Aria: I already opened a config change to set int8_enabled=false for that tenant and notified the customer. They asked for RCA and ETA.
Priya: instrumentation needed: emit quant.calibration_in_flight boolean, quant.calibration_latency_ms histogram, and correlate with inference.latency_ms and shard.restart_count. Also add trace_id logs for start/stop of calibration.
Nate: I'll prepare a runtime toggle we can flip fleet-wide: runtime.quant.online_calibration (hot config). That lets us turn off the behavior without redeploy.
Samir: also review fallback_threshold=0.98 — seems aggressive. And calibration_samples=2048 is too large for online sampling.
Helena: customer also reported subtle quality drift with int8 before fallback. They ran their eval and saw ~3% ROUGE drop with int8. We must clearly document that int8 can slightly change model outputs; recommend pre-eval.
Aria: after we flipped the runtime toggle and disabled online calibration for us-west1 the p95 dropped back close to baseline (~190ms). p99 remained a bit high for a few minutes while shards stabilized but improved.
deploy-bot: Applied config change: runtime.quant.online_calibration=false to fleet us-west1 at 2026-03-14T22:10Z (6/6 nodes).
Priya: next steps (proposed):
1) rollback tenant to fp16 (done) and confirm p95/p99 baseline
2) add metrics/logs/trace ids to detect calibration running in prod
3) implement offline/precompute calibration flow and background calibration workers
4) add safety gate: on distribution_mismatch do not perform immediate synchronous fallback + shard restarts; instead mark node degraded and route traffic to healthy replicas
Samir: quick doc + console UX: explain online vs offline calibration, recommend offline for production. Add recommended defaults: calibration_samples <= 512 for online, fallback_threshold >= 0.995 unless customer accepts quality variance.
Nate: I'll also wire a dashboard: quant.calibration_in_flight, quant.calibration_latency_ms, shard.restart_count, and an alert when quant.calibration_latency_ms > 250ms or shard restarts > 0 in 5m.
Helena: support will update the ticket with RCA and mitigation steps. Create an RFC for offline calibration flow and rollout checklist.
Aria: ticket update will include: root cause = online int8 calibration running on-prod, calibration mismatch triggered fallback to fp16 with shard restarts -> p95/p99 regression. Mitigations = disabled online calibration, rolled tenant to fp16, added monitoring, queued platform changes for background/offline calibration. :white_check_mark:
Samir: good. assign owners: Aria -> customer comms; Nate -> runtime toggle & dashboard; Priya -> RFC + logs/trace; Samir -> docs & tuning defaults.
Aria: will close SUP-10321 once customer confirms. Updating here after closure. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
